title: Academic Regulations
content: SRMIST operates under a Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) for all undergraduate and postgraduate programs. To graduate with a B.Tech degree, a student must accumulate a minimum of 160 credits (can vary slightly by branch) over 8 semesters. The assessment system consists of two parts: Internal Assessment (continuous evaluation worth 50% or 60% depending on regulation year) and End Semester Examinations (worth 50% or 40%). Internal evaluation includes cycle tests, surprise tests, quizzes, assignments, and laboratory assessments. The grading system uses letters (O for Outstanding, A+ for Excellent, A for Very Good, B+ for Good, B for Above Average, C for Average, P for Pass, and F for Fail). The Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is calculated on a 10-point scale. Passing a theory subject requires obtaining at least 50% overall and a minimum of 40% in the End Semester Examination.
